name: Nganjuk
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 queue point in latitude/longitude order; not shifted to force a parcel hit.
registryBasis: Official Nganjuk government reporting identifies Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Nganjuk as the local ATR/BPN land-registration custodian and documents its PTSL/GEMAPULDADIS work. This establishes the local registry custodian, but not an anonymous parcel geometry endpoint.
blocker: The official municipal geoportal route did not return within the bounded request, and the official LokaGeo catalog exposed administrative, hazard, road, planning, and facility datasets but no parcel/field layer. ATR/BPN/Sentuh Tanahku references describe property-specific lookup workflows, not a safe anonymous geometry-plus-stable-ID feed.

queries.query: Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Nganjuk resmi peta bidang tanah GIS geoportal
queries.result: Sumber resmi Nganjuk menyebut Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Nganjuk dalam program PTSL dan GEMAPULDADIS, serta menyebut Sentuh Tanahku untuk pencarian bidang tertentu. Katalog LokaGeo yang ditinjau tidak mempublikasikan layer bidang tanah; tidak ditemukan endpoint anonim yang aman.

officialSources.observation: Official Nganjuk Smart City report dated 2025-10-06 documents Kantah Kabupaten Nganjuk handing over PTSL certificates in Desa Setren and identifies the local land office as the implementing custodian.
Official Nganjuk Smart City report documents Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Nganjuk launching GEMAPULDADIS for PTSL 2026 and describes the goal of complete and accurate land-field mapping.

Official local report describes ATR/BPN Sentuh Tanahku's Cek Bidang workflow as a property-specific lookup requiring certificate/office/village identifiers or NIBEL; no public bulk geometry feed is provided.
Official-presented LokaGeo catalog page lists village boundaries, hazard zones, roads, RDTR zoning, and health facilities; no parcel or bidang tanah dataset was listed in the accessible catalog.
Official municipal directory links to GEOPORTAL, but the linked route was not available within the bounded anonymous request.

requests.assessment: Timed out after 15 seconds with no response bytes; this is an unavailable route outcome, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
Bounded request did not produce a usable response before timeout; no redirect or service configuration was inferred.
Catalog page returned and listed non-parcel datasets; no public parcel geometry layer, native parcel ID schema, CRS, or bounded feature query was exposed.
Municipal service directory returned and linked GEOPORTAL and Sentuh Tanahku; it did not expose a parcel API.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identity if documented
scopeLimits: No exact-point parcel query was made because no verified safe parcel endpoint/schema was found; the immutable WUP point remains unchanged.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, NIBEL, or other unsafe field was requested or retained.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.
A timeout, unavailable viewer, or absent public layer is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
Local registry evidence does not establish citywide public parcel coverage or runtime adapter suitability.

runtimeAssessment.reason: No public anonymous parcel geometry-plus-stable-ID route was verified; serial reviewer qualification remains required.
